decisive_items: A working diagnosis of probable RICH was made.
single, nonpulsatile, well-demarcated, dark brown atrophic plaque with a linear midline depression and an elevated, compressible, soft border that was paler than the central portion
AccuVein AV400 infrared vein finder was used; it revealed one large vein with an extensive network of small superficial branching vessels localized to the area of the atrophic plaque.
response.rationale: The vignette explicitly states a working diagnosis of probable RICH, and the clinical and imaging findings (atrophic plaque, visible vein, AccuVein findings) are consistent with RICH. No competing candidate was provided.
